evidence.quote: if (to < from) throw new DomainError(400, "to must not be before from");

rules.statement: The end date of a report range must be on or after its start date.
rules.subject: report range end date

rules.statement: A report range must not span more than the maximum allowed number of days (MAX_RANGE_DAYS).
rules.subject: report range length

rules.statement: A weekly report given a week start covers 7 days: the start day plus the following 6 days.
rules.subject: weekly report period
